status: PERIPHERAL SCHEMATIC DRAFT r2 - NO PCB RELEASE
component_count_meaning: Physical component positions, including DNP; not an approved assembly BOM.

erc.note: KiCad default rule profile retained; no project-level ERC exclusions added.

visual_review: All ten exported A3 PDF pages rendered to PNG and inspected; no clipped circuit, overlapping signal-label text or page-boundary issues observed. New EPD, SD and AUDIO pages included.
editor_state: KiCad was closed by the user before integration. No native editor interaction was needed this revision.
source_preservation: All20 preceding r1 verification hashes matched at intake. Pre-integration native files/README/verification copied under build/devboard-r2-intake. Legacy firmware and pre-existing dependencies.lock were not edited.
limitations: No PCB, assembled board, power/thermal/USB/ESD test or performance guarantee.
Battery capacity/protection/NTC curve/charging temperature window and connector remain pending; R108 stays DNP.
TPS63802 DLA footprint, panel/touch FPC contact face, USB and battery connectors, PUI microphone footprint/acoustic port and final power-component ratings remain pending.
PUI microphone, Vishay Si1308EDL and onsemi MBR0530 lifecycle/procurement require confirmation; named parts are candidates.
Hirose nonpolar detect pair mapped logically to KiCad9/10; exact mechanical A/B pad location requires source drawing/sample review.
Ioff and switch absolute ratings do not qualify all intermediate supply voltages; reset, rail ramps, injection/leakage and MIC/AMP unequal decay require measurements.
EPD SDI is write-only; PUI candidate needs a new board profile and shared I2S timing, initial48kHz/64fs. Legacy16kHz firmware remains unchanged.
USB source selection is manual/single-shunt; bench input bypasses USB branch protection.
QOD remains on load side of current links; opening0R alone does not fully isolate a rail.
EPD current-sense resistor, inductor, MLCC effective capacitance, SD card peaks and speaker output need electrical/thermal qualification.
